generation.stdout:
Done. `artifact.html` is written and verified end-to-end in a real browser (Chromium via Puppeteer, ARM build), with zero console or page errors.

## Requirements → verification evidence

| Requirement | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Self-contained, no external assets | Single HTML file, all CSS/JS inline |
| Analyser ≥ 60 bins | Instrumented `createAnalyser`: fftSize 512 → **256 frequency bins** (64 used per frame) |
| ≥3 modes, button-switchable | Bars / Rings / Particles; each button activates and each renders content (`brightRegions` > 200 for all three) |
| File input | Loaded a generated 4s WAV through the app's real `<input type=file>` → status "Playing: test.wav" |
| Microphone | Fake media device granted → "Listening to microphone", analyser receiving |
| Playback controls | Pause freezes time ✓ · Play resumes ✓ · Stop resets to 0:00 ✓ · Seek jumps to 50% (±0.6s) ✓ |
| Immediate visible animation | Canvas has pixels on first frames with no audio loaded (idle synthetic wave), animating at ~62fps |
| Smooth rendering | ~61fps during playback, no dropped-frame stalls |

One bug found and fixed during review: after using the mic, the graph kept `analyser → destination` connected, so the microphone would feed back to the speakers. Now `routeAnalyserToSpeakers()` explicitly disconnects the analyser for mic mode and reconnects it when a file plays.

Note: `artifact.html` was rewritten on disk between my first write and verification (different implementation, likely another writer in this eval workspace). I verified and fixed the version now on disk rather than reverting it — all results above are for that current file.
